name: Factorial
description: Computes n! = n × (n-1) × ... × 1. Demonstrates recursion vs iteration and the rapid growth of factorials.
aim: Calculate n factorial iteratively or recursively, illustrating how recursion creates a call stack and how memoization avoids recomputation.

complexity.spaceDescription: Iterative uses O(1); recursive uses O(n) stack

whenToUse: When intermediate results are also needed
alternatives: Stirling approximation — O(1) approximate for large n
Log-gamma function for floating point accuracy
